_about: On-demand LIST prices used to ESTIMATE what is running and billing. These are a bundled baseline (us-east-1, Linux on-demand) so the desktop app needs no pricing API and no extra AWS permission. They are estimates, not your invoice: real cost varies by region, OS, reservations/savings plans, and usage. Actual month-to-date spend comes from the opt-in Cost Explorer panel. Edit freely; every number is a plain USD/hour or USD/GB-month. Updated 2026-10 from public AWS pricing.

notes.elastic_ip: AWS now bills every allocated public IPv4 at ~$0.005/hr (~$3.6/mo), attached or not.
notes.nat_gateway: ~$0.045/hr (~$32.4/mo) plus per-GB data processing, which this estimate does not include.
notes.multi_az: Multi-AZ RDS roughly doubles the instance+storage cost; applied as x2 when MultiAZ is true.
